verses.en: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
verses.fr: Prophétie d''Abdias. Ainsi parle le Seigneur, l''Eternel, sur Edom: -Nous avons appris une nouvelle de la part de l''Eternel, Et un messager a été envoyé parmi les nations: Levez-vous, marchons contre Edom pour lui faire la guerre! -
verses.am: የአብድዩ ራእይ። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ኤዶምያስ እንዲህ ይላል። ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወሬ ሰምተናል፤ መልእክተኛ ወደ አሕዛብ ተልኮ። ተነሡ፥ በላይዋም በሰልፍ እንነሣ ብሎአል።

verses.en: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.
verses.fr: Voici, je te rendrai petit parmi les nations, Tu seras l''objet du plus grand mépris.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ታናሽ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ አንተ እጅግ ተንቀሃል።

verses.en: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
verses.fr: L''orgueil de ton coeur t''a égaré, Toi qui habites le creux des rochers, Qui t''assieds sur les hauteurs, Et qui dis en toi-même: Qui me précipitera jusqu''à terre?
verses.am: በተሰነጠቀ ዓለት ውስጥ የምትኖር፥ ማደሪያህንም ከፍ ከፍ ያደረግህ፥ በልብህም። ወደ ምድር የሚያወርደኝ ማን ነው? የምትል አንተ ሆይ፥ የልብህ ትዕቢት አታልሎሃል።

verses.en: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Quand tu placerais ton nid aussi haut que celui de l''aigle, Quand tu le placerais parmi les étoiles, Je t''en précipiterai, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ ንስር መጥቀህ ብትወጣ፥ ቤትህም በከዋክብት መካከል ቢሆን፥ ከዚያ አወርድሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?
verses.fr: Si des voleurs, des pillards, viennent de nuit chez toi, Comme te voilà dévasté! Mais enlèvent-ils plus qu''ils ne peuvent? Si des vendangeurs viennent chez toi, Ne laissent-ils rien à grappiller?...
verses.am: ሌቦች ቢመጡብህ ወይም ወንበዴዎች በሌሊት ቢመጡ፥ የሚበቃቸውን የሚሰርቁ አይደሉምን? ወይንንም የሚቈርጡ ወደ አንተ ቢመጡ ቃርሚያ አያስቀሩምን?

verses.en: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
verses.fr: Ah! comme Esaü est fouillé! Comme ses trésors sont découverts!
verses.am: አንተ ግን ምንኛ ጠፋህ! ዔሳው ምንኛ ተመረመረ! የተሸሸገበት ነገር ምንኛ ተፈለገ!

verses.en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.
verses.fr: Tous tes alliés t''ont chassé jusqu''à la frontière, Tes amis t''ont joué, t''ont dominé, Ceux qui mangeaient ton pain t''ont dressé des pièges, Et tu n''as pas su t''en apercevoir!
verses.am: የተማማልሃቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ ወደ ዳርቻህ ሰደዱህ፤ የታመንሃቸው ሰዎች አታለሉህ፥ አሸነፉህም፤ በበታችህም አሽክላ ዘረጉብህ፥ እነርሱም ማስተዋል የላቸውም።

verses.en: Shall I not in that day, saith the Lord, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas en ce jour, dit l''Eternel, Que je ferai disparaître d''Edom les sages, Et de la montagne d''Esaü l''intelligence?
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ከኤዶምያስ ጥበበኞችን፥ ከዔሳውም ተራራ ማስተዋልን አላጠፋምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
verses.fr: Tes guerriers, ô Théman, seront dans l''épouvante, Car tous ceux de la montagne d''Esaü périront dans le carnage.
verses.am: ቴማን ሆይ፥ ሰዎች ሁሉ ከዔሳው ተራራ በመገደል ይጠፉ ዘንድ ኃያላንህ ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
verses.fr: A cause de ta violence contre ton frère Jacob, Tu seras couvert de honte, Et tu seras exterminé pour toujours.
verses.am: በወንድምህ በያዕቆብ ላይ ስለ ተደረገ ግፍ እፍረት ይከድንሃል፥ ለዘላለምም ትጠፋለህ።

verses.en: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.
verses.fr: Le jour où tu te tenais en face de lui, Le jour où des étrangers emmenaient captive son armée, Où des étrangers entraient dans ses portes, Et jetaient le sort sur Jérusalem, Toi aussi tu étais comme l''un d''eux.
verses.am: በፊቱ አንጻር በቆምህ ቀን፥ አሕዛብ ጭፍራውን በማረኩበት፥ እንግዶችም በበሩ በገቡበት፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ዕጣ በተጣጣሉበት ቀን አንተ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ እንደ አንዱ ነበርህ።

verses.en: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.
verses.fr: Ne repais pas ta vue du jour de ton frère, du jour de son malheur, Ne te réjouis pas sur les enfants de Juda au jour de leur ruine, Et n''ouvre pas une grande bouche au jour de la détresse!
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመከራው ቀን ወንድምህን ትመለከት ዘንድ፥ በጥፋታቸውም ቀን በይሁዳ ልጆች ላይ ደስ ይልህ ዘንድ፥ በጭንቀትም ቀን በትዕቢት ትናገር ዘንድ አይገባህም ነበር።

verses.en: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;
verses.fr: N''entre pas dans les portes de mon peuple au jour de sa ruine, Ne repais pas ta vue de son malheur au jour de sa ruine, Et ne porte pas la main sur ses richesses au jour de sa ruine!
verses.am: በጥፋታቸውም ቀን በሕዝቤ በር ትገባ ዘንድ፥ በጥፋታቸውም ቀን መከራቸውን ትመለከት ዘንድ፥ በጥፋታቸውም ቀን በሀብታቸው ላይ እጅህን ትዘረጋ ዘንድ አይገባህም ነበር።

verses.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
verses.fr: Ne te tiens pas au carrefour pour exterminer ses fuyards, Et ne livre pas ses réchappés au jour de la détresse!
verses.am: የሸሹትንም ለመግደል በመንታ መንገድ ላይ ትቆም ዘንድ፥ በጭንቀትም ቀን ከእርሱ የቀሩትን አሳልፈህ ትሰጥ ዘንድ አይገባህም ነበር።

verses.en: For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
verses.fr: Car le jour de l''Eternel est proche, pour toutes les nations; Il te sera fait comme tu as fait, Tes oeuvres retomberont sur ta tête.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ቀርቦአልና፤ አንተ እንዳደረግኸው እንዲሁ ይደረግብሃል፥ ፍዳህም በራስህ ላይ ይመለሳል።

verses.en: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.
verses.fr: Car, comme vous avez bu sur ma montagne sainte, Ainsi toutes les nations boiront sans cesse; Elles boiront, elles avaleront, Et elles seront comme si elles n''avaient jamais été.
verses.am: በቅዱስ ተራራዬ ላይ እንደ ጠጣችሁ እንዲሁ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ዘወትር ይጠጣሉ፤ አዎን ይጠጣሉ፥ ይጨልጡማል፥ እንዳልሆኑም ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
verses.fr: Mais le salut sera sur la montagne de Sion, elle sera sainte, Et la maison de Jacob reprendra ses possessions.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ የሚያመልጡ ይሆናሉ፥ እርሱም ቅዱስ ይሆናል፤ የያዕቆብም ቤት ሰዎች ርስታቸውን ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.fr: La maison de Jacob sera un feu, et la maison de Joseph une flamme; Mais la maison d''Esaü sera du chaume, Qu''elles allumeront et consumeront; Et il ne restera rien de la maison d''Esaü, Car l''Eternel a parlé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ተናግሮአልና የያዕቆብ ቤት እሳት፥ የዮሴፍ ቤት ነበልባልም፥ የዔሳው ቤት ገለባ ይሆናሉ፤ እነርሱንም ያቃጥሉአቸዋል ይበሉአቸውማል፤ ከዔሳውም ቤት ቅሬታ የለውም።

verses.en: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
verses.fr: Ceux du midi posséderont la montagne d''Esaü, Et ceux de la plaine le pays des Philistins; Ils posséderont le territoire d''Ephraïm et celui de Samarie; Et Benjamin possédera Galaad.
verses.am: የደቡብም ሰዎች የዔሳውን ተራራ፥ የቈላውም ሰዎች ፍልስጥዔማውያንን ይወርሳሉ፤ የኤፍሬምንም አገር የሰማርያንም አገር ይወርሳሉ፤ ብንያምም ገለዓድን ይወርሳል።

verses.en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.
verses.fr: Les captifs de cette armée des enfants d''Israël Posséderont le pays occupé par les Cananéens jusqu''à Sarepta, Et les captifs de Jérusalem qui sont à Sepharad Posséderont les villes du midi.
verses.am: ይህም የእስራኤል ልጆች የጭፍራቸው ምርኮ የከነዓንን ስፍራ ሁሉ እስከ ሰራጵታ ድረስ ይወርሳል፤ በስፋራድም የሚኖሩ የኢየሩሳሌም ምርኮኞች የደቡብን ከተሞች ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord's.
verses.fr: Des libérateurs monteront sur la montagne de Sion, Pour juger la montagne d''Esaü; Et à l''Eternel appartiendra le règne.
verses.am: በዔሳውም ተራራ ላይ ይፈርዱ ዘንድ አዳኞች ወደ ጽዮን ተራራ ላይ ይወጣሉ፤ መንግሥቱም ለእግዚአብሔር ይሆናል።
